verdict.rationale: Pigment documents scenario runs at the touch of a button to assess different assumptions (shown in a workforce-planning context). Its budget-planning page shows a projected year-end cash KPI, so cash projection and scenario comparison are both first-party capabilities. Nothing ties the two together, however: there is no explicit burn or runway calculation and no zero-cash-date output per scenario. Missing for 10: documented burn and runway metrics, per-scenario cash runway or zero-cash-date computation, side-by-side scenario impact on the cash-out date, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
